_help: AIR Career Program (seen 2026-10-12). Four careers, each 750 career points (CP) to graduate; overall 3,000 CP. Sub-goals are bubbles inside each career. Edit from screenshots.

Enforcer.note: Seen 2026-10-13. 125 CP from Standings 4/4 + Market 3/4 only (7 goals, ~18 CP each avg). Career Agent Missions 0/10 here (separate from the Soldier of Fortune missions). Graduation: 100,000 SP (Omega) + 100,000 SP + Caracal/Rupture/Thorax/Omen Aspirant Enforcer SKINs. Market 3/4: the Enforcer Market goals probably share the ISK-earned-on-market counter with Industrialist.

Explorer.note: Seen 2026-10-13. 60 CP = 5 goals done (2 missions + Hacking 1 + Combat Sites 1 + Navigation 1): 12 CP each on average. Only 5 career agent missions here. Graduation: 100,000 SP (Omega) + 100,000 SP + Heron/Magnate/Imicus/Probe/Astero Aspirant Explorer SKINs. Update 2026-10-18 1:25 am: 150 CP (was 110): +40 CP from the Navigation goals reached while flying around (stargate jumps). Update 2026-10-21 18:42: 230 CP (was 150): +80 CP; bubbles not re-checked.

Industrialist.note: Seen 2026-10-13. 255 CP = 7 missions x10 = 70 + 185 from 7 other goals (4 Market,1 Salvage,1 Resource Harvesting,1 Manufacturing): ~26 CP each on average, so these goals pay MORE CP than missions: hover each to see. Market 4/5 means one more Market goal is probably cheap. Market goals are cumulative 'Earn X ISK on the Market' (click the bubble to open its sub-circle; hover does not). Last one: 402,300 ISK left; trading finishes it.

market_goals.Earn 1,000,000: 597,700/1,000,000 (402,300 ISK still to earn on the market)

Soldier of Fortune.note: 35 CP = 30 from three missions + 5 from Destruction 1/5 (so Destruction goals likely give 5 CP each). Bubble rewards other than Career Agent Missions not seen yet. Goal list seen 2026-10-12; career points per goal NOT seen (hover one goal bubble). Social goals are one-click cheap: chat message, add contact, EVE mail, join fleet; 'Join a Corporation' changes your corp, do not do it blindly.

goals.not yet seen: Capacitor Warfare 0/6, Electronic Warfare 0/5, PvP 0/4, Faction Warfare 0/5

Soldier of Fortune.goal_reward_seen: Send a Message in Chat: 25,000 ISK + 10 CP, risk none. Lose 5 Ships: 25,000 ISK + 10 CP, risk HIGH (corvettes do not count). Goals appear to pay 25,000 ISK + 10 CP each, like the missions. Combat tooltip not captured.

items_held.AIR Agility Booster II: 1 in the Item hangar (Lai Dai station, 2026-10-18). -10% ship inertia for 1 hour: faster align/warp-out, so slightly shorter gate hops. Worth using at the start of a long gate-hopping trip (about 1 hour); no ISK value.
